normalized.result: Yes, that's the behavior I expect. Even with a big pile of bookmarks, typing "accessibility" narrowed it right down to the one matching card — that's exactly why search matters once I've saved a lot. And the unusually long name, address, and collection name are all kept tidy (the long bits trimmed with "…") while the card stays readable, and it still found the match inside that long text. Having the full list just scroll when unfiltered is fine, since search and the collection filters are the quick way back. This works for me.
